assessment.why: Artie has the clearest threatened personal loss, but nothing ties any guest to stolen poison or a poisoned drink. There is not yet a reported death.

plausibility_notes: Forced theft of a still-filled historical poison bottle provides possible means; Grant claiming it was emptied is unverified. Sideboard is public and gift bottles are widespread.
